item.title: Milwaukee convenience store owner charged in $1.6 million SNAP fraud scheme
item.description: Former Milwaukee convenience store owner Nael Jabbar is charged with wire fraud after allegedly running a $1.6 million SNAP benefits scheme.

item.title: Brookfield vegetarian café to close after 18 years
item.description: Brookfield’s Café Manna, a vegetarian café located at 3815 N. Brookfield Road in Sendik’s Towne Centre, will close in March after 18 years in business. item.title: Harley-Davidson CEO plans culture rebuild at Milwaukee HQ
item.description: Harley-Davidson plans a culture reset at its Milwaukee headquarters as it navigates a year of transition in 2026 with a new strategic plan in the works.

item.title: Kevin Youngberg
item.description: Southeast Sales Powersports promotes Kevin Youngberg to Manager of Government & Fleet Sales. He will lead strategy, expand brand awareness, and drive growth across government and commercial fleet markets, including ATV and side-by-side sales.
